title: Energy estimates of open-weight large language models across stated food weights: a dose-response evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2611.25976v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We tested whether energy estimates of open-weight large language models (LLMs) scale proportionally with an exactly stated food weight, and whether computing energy density times weight removes the error. Under a prespecified protocol, seven open-weight LLMs estimated the energy of 168 randomly drawn foods from the USDA Food and Nutrient Database for Dietary Studies at nine stated weights, from 0.25 to 4 times the default amount. The primary outcome was the elasticity of the estimate with respect to weight (1: proportional scaling). A two-step estimate multiplied each model's own stated energy density by the weight in code. All seven models compressed their estimates, with elasticities from 0.548 to 0.979 (every 95% CI below 1); four compressed severely (0.548 to 0.709). translated_title: 开源权重大型语言模型在不同给定食物重量下的能量估计：一项剂量-反应评估
translated_abstract: 我们检验了开源权重大型语言模型（LLM）的能量估计是否随精确给定的食物重量成比例变化，以及通过“能量密度×重量”的计算方式能否消除误差。在一项预先设定的协议下，七个开源权重LLM对从美国农业部膳食研究食物与营养素数据库中随机抽取的168种食物，在九个给定重量（为默认量的0.25倍至4倍）下估计其能量。主要结局指标是估计值相对于重量的弹性（1表示成比例缩放）。两步估计法是在代码中将每个模型自己给出的能量密度乘以重量。结果显示，所有七个模型都压缩了其估计值，弹性范围为0.548至0.979（所有95%置信区间均低于1）；其中四个模型压缩严重（0.548至0.709）。这四个模型在默认量四分之一时高估能量47%至130%，在默认量四倍时低估能量20%至34%。提供能量密度后可恢复接近成比例的缩放……
tldr: 七个开源大语言模型在估计食物能量时无法随给定重量成比例缩放（弹性仅0.548-0.979），导致小份量被高估、大份量被低估，而采用“模型自报能量密度×重量”的两步法可基本消除该误差。
en_tdlr: Seven open-weight LLMs fail to scale food energy estimates proportionally with stated weights (elasticities 0.548–0.979), overestimating small portions and underestimating large ones, but a two-step method multiplying each model's own stated energy density by the weight nearly eliminates the error.
